verdict.rationale: Tilled documents white-label hosting of its API, merchant onboarding, and reporting console on the partner's own domain for Enterprise partners, which gives a branded seller-facing surface. However, users stay within the Tilled login experience, so this is a hosted white-label console rather than components embedded in the developer's product. No documented embeddable components or APIs specifically for balances, payouts, or transaction history appear in the evidence; payouts are only shown viewable in the Dashboard. Missing for 10: embeddable white-label UI components, documented balance/payout/transaction-history APIs for in-product display, availability beyond Enterprise tier, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: Enterprise partners have the ability to host their API, merchant onboarding, and reporting console experiences on a domain that reflects their own identity
Now the API, console, and dev portal can appear using your base domain (https://example.com).
White-label custom domains allow Enterprise partners who want to white-label their user links to appear as their own entity while staying within the Tilled login experience.
